fresh_selector: Save the first seed's initial fitted/calibrated ensemble, normalization and checkpoint before ANY pool-label reveal; never choose best seed or adapted replay snapshot.

fresh_shortlist.diversity_anchors: Frozen initialtraining plus alreadychosen sameformula candidate; formulas ranked independently
fresh_shortlist.tie_break: lexicographic candidateID; originalorder saved before relaxation
fresh_shortlist.early_DFT_cohort: First8CaMg2O3SG2attempts,2batchesof4, before the other default new-formula cohorts; report earlycohort provenance, not bestoflaterfullpool
fresh_shortlist.early_DFT_selection: Select atmost2fromthatcohort with frozenpairfunction; pre-relax eachonce inselectororder; firstDFTjob retains initialselectororder among eligibleconverged results

DFT_pre_relaxation_eligibility.classification: Representation-sensitive workloadfilters onactualexecutedcell, not physicalphaseclassification or evidence of thermodynamicinstability; retainallrejectionsandreason

fresh_shortlist.no_outcome_reordering: Do not reprioritize using CHGNetenergies; if two selected structures collapse intoonephase, reportoneunique rather than chase replacements

known_MgO_DFT_fallback.trigger: Onlyif firstCaMg2O3cohorthasnovaliduniquecandidate or noneofthechosenmaximum2isconvergedandeligible; documentoriginalfailures; never switch becausecandidateDFTenergyisundesirable

fresh_shortlist.stretch: For8formulas, firstoneconservativecandidateeach; up4secondcandidates rankedbytheir optimisticpairscore withcandidateIDties; total12maximum
fresh_shortlist.reserves: Admitinrecordedreserveorder onlywithinremainingbudgets; retain originaldefaultfailures as distinctcohorts. No outcome-dependentmanualreserveordering
fresh_shortlist.calibration_and_model_snapshot: Samefixedinitialseed20261022snapshotforallfreshcohorts; no refit from replay or freshQEoutcomes

ensemble.seed_rule: numpy.random.SeedSequence([paired_seed,round_index,member_index,11]); separate generated uint32 seeds for outer bootstrap and ExtraTrees
ensemble.prediction: arithmetic mean of five member predictions
ensemble.disagreement: sample standard deviation across five member means, ddof=1
ensemble.refit: Fit all five new members after each batch using initial training plus only that policy's revealed IDs; no cross-policy sharing of queried labels

calibration.recalibration: Recompute residual quantile after each policy refit on the same calibration population; never tune model/scoring coefficients from pool outcomes
calibration.coverage_claim: Empirical only; chemical-system shift and repeated adaptive use do not establish arbitrary-OOD coverage

diversity.normalize: Column mean and population std fitted ONCE on initial training only; std<1e-12 replaced by1; clip z to[-5,5]
diversity.known_set: initial training plus previously queried rows and current within-batch choices; calibration is not a diversity anchor

acquisition.label_boundary: select_batch accepts IDs,predictions,radii,features,distances,RNG only; no oracle label argument; reveal labels only after decision is serialized

evaluation_population.yield_and_query_coverage: That policy's selected50poolrows, with cumulative metrics at each10-query batch
evaluation_population.MAE_RMSE_Spearman_interval_coverage_and_: Fixed3418rows in each seed's existing unused partition; neverqueried or used for training, calibration, normalization or diversity anchors
evaluation_population.paired_policies: Identical evaluation IDs for allfive policies within each seed
evaluation_population.evaluation_label_access: Separate evaluator only; log predictions/decisions first. No evaluator label or metric may affect a fit, selection, hyperparameter or early-stop decision

generation.prototype_accounting: Charge each of the four original prepared substitution candidates once; copies/conversions do not create attempts
generation.pilot_reuse: MgO SG225 first8 reused only if exact frozen settings preserved; otherwise all8 remain charged engineering attempts

chgnet_reallocation.symmetry_reason: MgO at most1uniqueperarm=2; secondcontrol atmost4perarm=8; always q=min(4,nvalidSG,nvalidP1)

budget_aggregation_requirement: All new phase ledgers must be explicitly registered in the cumulative ledger; Phase1 finalizer alone does not discover future ledgers.
